name: round3-history-map-inbox
goal: Three pure modules for finishing The Crew (Round 3, 2026-10-26): history_docs.py turns jobs and documents into search records and safe FTS5 queries; codemap.py outlines Python/JS/Rust/AHK files and maps a repository; inbox.py orders the cards Kris lands on. The PA wires them into the index, member tools, CLI and window.

tasks.instructions: Walk every worked-example row. fts_query walks the text ONCE with the one regex the contract gives; a phrase and a word are both terms, compared whole for duplicates. Every record has exactly the eight keys, all strings.
tasks.test_instructions: Cover every table row, an FTS5 operator word typed by a person (NOT, OR, NEAR), a column-filter colon, an unmatched quote, the max_terms cap, frontmatter with CRLF lines, a title containing a colon, and the body cap.

tasks.instructions: Walk every worked-example row. Copy each regex from the contract exactly; the rules for a language apply in order and the first match wins. Python uses ast first and falls back to the two line regexes only on SyntaxError. In AHK only column-0 lines define anything.
tasks.test_instructions: Cover every table row, the Python fallback on a syntax error, a decorated def, the AHK next-line brace rule with a comment line between, excluded AHK keywords, rust impl names with generics, and repo_map's cap (a block that does not fit, and the first block not fitting).

tasks.instructions: Walk every worked-example row. Each input item gives at most one card; a job that is a question card is never also a finished card. 'After seen_at' is a plain string comparison and an empty time is never after. Sort by rank, then when newest first, then title.
tasks.test_instructions: Cover every table row, the order (rank, then newest when, then title, with an empty when last), an answered question becoming a finished card, a campaign exactly at the stale limit, seen_at empty, and counts.
